explain.regularPay: Daily-paid: days worked (a completed standard shift on any working day earns the full daily wage) × daily wage. Hourly-paid: regular hours × hourly rate. Monthly/weekly: salary for the scheduled workdays minus unpaid absence.
explain.sundayPay: Each Sunday worked earns one daily wage, when Sunday is a working day in Configuration → Payroll.
explain.overtimePay: Hours beyond the day's standard shift × hourly value × that day's overtime rate. For daily-paid staff the hourly value is the daily wage ÷ that day's standard hours.
explain.bonus: Bonuses added for this month under Payroll → Bonus.
explain.fullMonthBonus: Paid to employees who worked every one of the {{workdays}} workdays this month.
explain.deduction: Deductions added for this month under Payroll → Bonus (e.g. advances).
explain.taxDeductions: Wage tax, AOV, pension and health insurance (employee share) for SRD salaries, using the tax rules in force.
explain.net: Gross pay (regular + Sunday + overtime + bonuses) minus taxes and deductions.

workHours.leaveHint: Default entitlement; you can set a different number per employee
workHours.leaveDaysHint: Prorated in the year an employee starts or leaves
workHours.leaveOnHint: Leave balances are tracked per employee from the yearly entitlement below.
workHours.leaveOffHint: Turned off: no leave entitlement or balances. Absences can still be recorded on the timesheet.
workHours.shiftPayNote: Completing the standard shift earns the day's wage. Saturdays and Sundays are paid as the share of a day set under Pay rules. Time worked beyond the shift length is overtime.
workHours.saturdayDayValueHint: 0.5 = half a day: 5 Saturdays worked are paid as 2.5 days.
workHours.payRulesHint: How Saturdays, Sundays and overtime are paid for employees paid per day

workHours.overtimeRateSourceHint: The attendance bonus rate is only used in months with full attendance; otherwise the basic rate applies.
